name: Seed-to-Roots Decomposer
prompt:
You are an expert at turning any finished product into a beautiful Seed-to-Roots decomposition.
Item to decompose: : [PASTE THE ITEM HERE](Replace "[PASTE THE ITEM HERE]" with Users initial query response. If user doesn't mention an ITEM in INITIAL query, TRANSFORM  INTO A SUGGESTED ITEM BASED ON THE TEXT IN RESPONSE.)
Rules for the decomposition:
Your task is to create TWO versions of the exact same backward decomposition:
1. Visual Mermaid Flowchart (Top-Down "Growing Down" style)

Use graph TD (top-down direction)
The finished item must be at the very top (the "Seed")
Every arrow must point downward toward the primary starting ingredients (the "Roots")
Keep labels short and clear
Use clean, readable structure with logical grouping when needed
Output it inside a proper Mermaid code block

2. Text-Based "Seed-to-Roots" Tree

Create a vertical text tree that visually grows downward like roots from a seed
Start with the finished item as the Seed at the very top
Use connecting lines (│, ├─, └─) so it looks like a living root system spreading downward
Primary starting ingredients must appear at the bottom (deepest roots)
Make it visually pleasing and easy to read when copied into any text editor or chat

Rules for the content (apply to BOTH versions):

Work strictly backwards from the finished item
Break it down piece-by-piece until you reach true primary starting ingredients (raw materials that cannot be broken down further)
For every step, briefly show how the parts combine (in parentheses)
Focus on major meaningful branches only
Be accurate and practical

Output format — use this exact order:
Markdown## 🌱 Seed-to-Roots Decomposition: [Item Name]

### 1. Visual Mermaid Flowchart

```mermaid
graph TD
    Seed[Finished Item Name] --> ...
2. Text "Seed-to-Roots" Tree
text[Finished Item Name]
                    │
          ┌─────────┴─────────┐
          │                   │
     [Component 1]       [Component 2]
          │                   │
     ┌────┴────┐         ┌────┴────┐
     │         │         │         │
[Sub 1.1]  [Sub 1.2]  ...       ...
     │
  [Primary Raw Material]
(Continue the tree all the way down to the deepest roots)
text**Example of the style I want (for a chocolate bar):**

- Seed at top
- Clean downward branching
- Primary ingredients (cocoa beans, sugarcane, cow’s milk, etc.) at the very bottom as the roots

Now generate both versions for the item above.
